title: The site looks the same on the base theme plus its brand pack
description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-64506d.

Compare home, section and article pages with the current site at phone, laptop and wide widths; they must match. Site hooks no longer build cards or layout. Go through the preview and the normal release flow.
